metadata.description: Syncwise is a SaaS startup founded in 2024 that streamlines cross-company project collaboration for distributed teams. Its platform integrates project management, document sharing, and real-time communication, helping mid-sized businesses reduce friction and improve productivity. After validating product-market fit in its first year, Syncwise is now scaling operations and expanding its customer base.

roadmap.narrative_description: Syncwise expands its closed beta to onboard 10 new mid-sized companies, gathering broader feedback and validating core features in diverse environments.
Launches a new module for real-time document editing, addressing a top user request and enabling smoother workflow integrations.
Closes a $2M seed round led by a prominent early-stage VC, providing capital for product development and go-to-market activities.
Onboards experienced engineers and a growth lead, strengthening technical and marketing capabilities for the next phase.
Secures its first paid subscription from a mid-sized consultancy, validating pricing and value proposition.
Releases public APIs, enabling customers to integrate Syncwise with their internal systems and third-party tools.
Establishes formal onboarding and support processes to reduce churn and ensure user adoption.
Signs a contract with a regional tech firm for 100+ seats, marking the company’s first significant enterprise deal.
Debuts Syncwise’s mobile app for iOS and Android, extending collaboration to teams on the go.
Completes a third-party security audit, boosting trust among enterprise prospects and preparing for compliance certifications.
Onboards its first European customer and localizes the platform for German and French markets.
Celebrates surpassing 5,000 active users, demonstrating sustained growth and preparing for the next phase of scaling.
